items.headline: Democrats ko House me 258 seatein
items.detail: North Carolina me Chuck Hubbard ki jeet ke baad Democrats ke paas House me kam se kam 258 seatein ho gayin — 1992 ke baad sabse bada bahumat; chaar seatein abhi bhi tay nahi hui hain.
items.exam_angle: America midterm chunav 2026, House bahumat — UPSC IR

items.headline: Benghazi me Russian yuddhpot par drone hamla
items.detail: Ravivaar ko Libya ke Benghazi bandargah par khade Russian yuddhpot Merkury par sandigdh drone hamle se dhamaka hua — jahaaz aadha doob gaya aur 10 log halke ghayal hue; Malta ke jhande wala ek vyaparik jahaaz bhi nishana bana.
items.exam_angle: Libya, Russia-Ukraine yuddh, samudri suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: West Bank me aagjani, Eisenkot ne ninda ki
items.detail: Ravivaar raat Ramallah ke paas ke gaonvon me basne walon ne kam se kam 12 gaadiyan jala di — sarkar banane ki koshish kar rahe Gadi Eisenkot ne ise 'Yahudi aatankwad' kaha; koi ghayal nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Palestine, West Bank hinsa — UPSC IR

items.headline: Eisenkot ne Netanyahu se gathbandhan vaarta shuru ki
items.detail: Israel me sarkar banane ki zimmedari wale Gadi Eisenkot ne Netanyahu ki Likud party ko gathbandhan vaarta ke liye bulaya; Updated: ravivaar ko dono dalon ki pehli baithak hui, Eisenkot ke paas 6 December tak ka samay hai — 27 October ke chunav me kisi ko bahumat nahi mila tha.
items.exam_angle: Israel sarkar-gathan, Netanyahu — UPSC IR

items.headline: Killer robot niyam 2028 tak tale
items.detail: Geneva me sanyukt rashtra ki vaarta me 128 deshon ne ghatak swayatt hathiyaron par sambhav samjhote ko 2028 tak taiyar karne par sahmati di — America, Russia aur Israel ke virodh se bandhankari niyam nahi bane.
items.exam_angle: LAWS, CCW, swayatt hathiyar — UPSC IR/Science & Tech

items.headline: Riyadh ki taraf drone, Saudi ne roka
items.detail: Ravivaar ko Saudi gathbandhan ne Houthi ka Riyadh kshetra ki taraf aaya drone roka aur gira diya; gathbandhan ke mutabik 24 ghante me roka gaya yeh chautha Houthi hamla hai.
items.exam_angle: Houthi-Saudi sangharsh, Riyadh suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Bolsonaro ICU me, pet me rukavat
items.detail: Brazil ke poorv rashtrapati Jair Bolsonaro ko pet me gambhir rukavat ke kaaran Brasilia ke DF Star hospital ke ICU me bharti kiya gaya — ve sthir aur hosh me hain; takhtapalat ki sajish me 27 saal ki saza kaat rahe hain.
items.exam_angle: Brazil, Bolsonaro, takhtapalat sajish — UPSC IR

items.headline: COP31 bina samjhote ke khatm, EU ne thukraya
items.detail: Antalya me COP31 ka antim samjhota bina sahmati ke khatm ho gaya — EU aur Panama ne 'fossil fuels' ka zikr na hone par masaude ko thukraya; 2009 Copenhagen ke baad pehli baar koi samjhota nahi bana.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu samjhauta, 1.5°C — UPSC Environment

items.headline: Kyiv kshetra me drone hamla, 2 mare
items.detail: Ravivaar subah Ukraine ke Kyiv kshetra ke Dymer me Russian drone hamle se paanch-manzila imarat ka hissa gir gaya — nau log nikale gaye. Corrected: ab tak 2 ki maut hui (ek 18 saal ka yuvak), 4 ghayal hue aur 11 log malbe me dabey hain; bachaav kaam jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh, drone hamle — UPSC IR

items.headline: Lisbon me mehengaai ke khilaf hazaaron utre
items.detail: Shanivaar ko Portugal ki rajdhani Lisbon me hazaaron log bhari baarish ke beech mehengaai, awas sankat aur kam vetan ke khilaf sadkon par utre — sabse bade mazdoor sangathan CGTP ne zyada vetan aur sasti zaroori cheezon ki maang ki.
items.exam_angle: Portugal, Europe me mehengaai virodh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Myanmar ne ASEAN faisle ko 'unfair' kaha
items.detail: Myanmar ki sena-samarthit sarkar ne Shanivaar ko ASEAN ke faisle ko 'unfair aur imbalanced' kaha — Manila shikhar sammelan me poori pratinidhitva se vanchit rakhne par bhedbhaav ka aarop lagaya; ASEAN ne paanch-sutriya shanti yojana par pragati ki shart rakhi hai.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN, Myanmar sankat — UPSC IR

items.headline: Baltic me Russian jahaaz par drone hamla
items.detail: Shanivaar ko Baltic Sagar me Russian cargo jahaaz Sparta II par drone hamle ke baad aag lag gayi — Finland ke anusar hamle ke peeche Ukraine hone ki sambhavna hai; 16 chaalak-dal surakshit nikale gaye, jahaaz Finland ke jal me langar par hai aur aag abhi bhi jal rahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Baltic Sagar, Ukraine yuddh, Finland-NATO — UPSC IR

items.headline: Khartoum me drone hamle, ghar tabah
items.detail: Ravivaar subah Sudan ki rajdhani Khartoum me drone hamle hue — subah 2 baje se 4:30 tak dhamake hote rahe, kai ghar tabah ho gaye; abhi tak koi hatahat ki khabar nahi hai. Sudan sena ne hawai raksha sakriya kar di, hamle ke peeche kaun hai ye abhi saaf nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Sudan grih yuddh, drone yuddh, manaviya sankat — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iran ke tel dalalon par America ka pratibandh
items.detail: US Treasury ne chaar Iraniyon par pratibandh lagaya — ve Iran ke tel ki videsh bikri se arbon dollar vasool kar rahe the; unki sampatti jabt hogi aur dollar len-den band. Ye kadam Operation Economic Outcast ke tahat uthaya gaya.
items.exam_angle: Iran par pratibandh, Operation Economic Outcast, tel vyapar — UPSC IR

items.headline: El Chapo Isidro ki giraftari me 11 mare
items.detail: Sinaloa ke Guasave me cartel neta Fausto Isidro Meza Flores ki giraftari ke dauran hui hinsa me 11 log mare — saat sandigdh bandukdhari aur chaar sipahi; use Mexico City le jaya gaya hai.
items.exam_angle: Mexico drug cartel, FBI most-wanted, America-Mexico — UPSC IR

items.headline: Hormuz me do tanker par hamla
items.detail: UKMTO ne bataya Shanivar ko Hormuz jaladmaru-madhya me do tanker par agyaat projectile se hamla hua — ek ki stern, doosre ke engine room par; koi ghayal nahi hua. Iran ne ek tanker ke mine se takrane ka dava kiya, jiski swatantra pushti nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Strait of Hormuz, tel vyapar, Iran-America yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: COP31 draft me 'fossil fuels' shabd nahi
items.detail: Antalya me COP31 ke antim masaude me 'fossil fuels', tel ya koyla ka zikr hi nahi — 2035 tak bijli ki hissedari 35% ka lakshya hai, aur masaude me pehli baar 1.5°C paar hone ki chinta jatai gayi; manzoori par baatchit jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu samjhauta, 1.5°C — UPSC Environment

items.headline: Iran ka F-16 dava, America ne nakara
items.detail: Iran ne dava kiya uski vayu raksha ne Farsi ki Khadi me US F-16 ko nishana banaya; US Central Command ne ise 'false report' batakar kharij kiya, saare jet surakshit hain.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America yuddh, F-16 dava — UPSC IR

items.headline: Bangladesh me hinsa: Narail me ghar jalaye
items.detail: Bangladesh me rajnaitik hinsa jaari hai: Narail me BNP netaon ki hatya ke baad darjanon ghar aur dukanein jalayi gayin, Pabna me bhi jhadap hui; pichhle hafte chaar log mare gaye.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh rajnaitik sankat, Bharat sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iran ke 14 tanker naakaabandi todne ko taiyar
items.detail: Kharg Island par 14 se zyada tel tanker taiyar hain, dal aur Iran ka jhanda chadha hai; up-mantri ne naakaabandi ko 'yuddh ka kaam' batakar todne ki chetavni di, abhi kafila rawana hone ki swatantra pushti nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America yuddh, Hormuz, tel naakaabandi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Dakshin Korea ke shiksha mantri ne istifa diya
items.detail: Shiksha mantri Choi Kyo-jin ne AI se cheating rokne ki taiyari me hui gadbad ki zimmedari lete hue istifa diya; Rashtrapati Lee ne turant manzoor kiya, pariksha me electronic device se 111 gadbad ke mamle mile.
items.exam_angle: Pariksha me AI cheating, Suneung — UPSC Ethics/Tech

items.headline: Indonesia factory aag: 7 shav, 50 lapata
items.detail: Ravivaar tak Indonesia ke Cikande candy factory ki aag me saat body bag mile aur lagbhag 50 mazdoor abhi bhi lapata hain — aag ki teevrata se pehchan mushkil, DNA jaanch me do-teen hafte lag sakte hain; shift me lagbhag 300 log maujood the.

items.headline: Gaza: khane wali gaadi par hamla, teen mare
items.detail: Gaza City ke Tel al-Hawa me khana pahuncha rahi gaadi par Israeli hamle me teen log mare gaye; Israel ne kaha woh Islamic Jihad ke ladake the, Hamas ne madhyasthon ki turant baithak mangi.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram, Israel-Hamas — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iran me bijli rationing, ravivaar se katoti
items.detail: Yuddh se urja dhacha kshatigrast hone par Iran ne ravivaar se rolling power cut ki ghoshna ki — ilaake ke hisab se har do din me ya roz do ghante tak bijli band rahegi.
items.exam_angle: Iran urja sankat, yuddh ka asar — UPSC IR/Economy
